diagnostics.message: routes a capability declared `escalatable: true` and has no "escalated" template (names "undefined"). A run can end with a step handed to a human, and the two things the customer must be told are that the act awaits review AND that the rest of the route did not run — an approval resumes the escalated activity alone. `failed` would say nothing happened, which closes a matter that is still open.
